module.name: TIDAL
module.author: morieattonkatsu; Natune contributors
module.description: TIDAL audio from your signed-in account or your HTTPS public/community instance. Choose the connection mode in settings. No account or instance credentials are bundled.

mode.label: Connection mode
mode.description: Choose your own account or a public/community instance without an account.

instanceUrl.label: Instance URL
instanceUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint used only in public instance mode.

accessToken.label: Access token
accessToken.description: Static OAuth access token for your TIDAL account. Replace it here when it expires.

countryCode.label: Country code
countryCode.description: Two-letter catalog region, such as US. Leave empty to use your account's region.

refreshToken.label: Refresh token
refreshToken.description: Optional personal OAuth refresh token. Rotated tokens are retained only while the engine lives.

clientId.label: OAuth client ID
clientId.description: Your OAuth client identifier for token refresh; no identifier is bundled.

clientSecret.label: OAuth client secret
clientSecret.description: Optional confidential OAuth client secret, only when required by your client.

qualityOptions.label: Max · Hi-Res FLAC
qualityOptions.description: Up to 24-bit/192 kHz FLAC delivered through DASH. TIDAL returns lossless when a track or client has no Hi-Res version.

qualityOptions.label: High · FLAC 16-bit/44.1 kHz
qualityOptions.description: CD-quality FLAC as a single file.

qualityOptions.label: Data saver · AAC 96 kbps
qualityOptions.description: AAC at 96 kbps to reduce data usage.
